scoring_justification: The transition temperatures are recomputed from the agent's δ(T) data and compared to paper-reported values, using tolerance-based scoring. This is a direct recompute from the submitted processed artifact.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference melting transition temperatures (onset, intermediate steps, completion) and expected specific-heat peak temperatures for Na8 and Na20 clusters
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text and Abstract; extracted approximate values (Na8: onset ~110 K, fully liquid ~220 K; Na20: Tm1~110 K, Tm2~160 K, complete liquid ~220 K).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manually extracted from the paper's discussion of Figures 2 and 4 and the Summary section.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual physical conclusions reported by the paper; using the published approximate temperatures as reference targets is the only way to verify that the agent's simulation correctly captures the melting transitions.

outputs.description: Computed temperature, bond length fluctuation and specific heat for Na8. The checker will extract transition temperatures from δ(T) and compare against hidden reference values.
Computed temperature, bond length fluctuation and specific heat for Na20. The checker will extract transition temperatures from δ(T) and compare against hidden reference values.

output_contract.notes: The checker identifies melting transition temperatures from the δ vs T data and compares them to reference values within tolerance. No paper-specific details are provided in the public contract.
